verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
MMUNYEENYE-eyakira bonna
-Abatambula-ekiro!
Otwakire otuwonye
Mu nzikiza yaffe.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Jjangu! Muwanguzi waffe,
Yolesa-amaanyi go,
Ensi zonna zikusuute,
Zikugulumize.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Leero-ebitonde byo byonna
Bikaaba bisinda,
Awamu n'emyoyo gyaffe
Nga tukusuubira.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ggwe-eyeetikka-omusaalaba
Otuwonye-okufa.
Musuutwa waffe, labika,
Jjangu:tukwetaaga.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Labika n'ekitiibwa kyo,
Weetikkira-engule,
Naffe ne bamalayika
Tusinzize wamu
